MUZE 5th Anniversary Showcase
Sofia, Bulgaria
This October, we had the pleasure of celebrating the 5th birthday of our partners – MUZE!
This October, we had the pleasure of celebrating the 5th birthday of our partners – MUZE!
The celebration took place at Sofia Live Club with an impressive showcase featuring over 10 talented artists performing brand-new, unreleased songs in both Bulgarian and English.

During the event, MUZE also announced the launch of a new strategic partnership, opening the door to truly global opportunities for the artists, authors, labels, and publishers they represent — a big milestone for the Bulgarian music scene.
A big congratulations to Marko Anastasov and the entire MUZE team for their expertise, dedication, and motivation in driving the industry forward.
We’re proud to stand alongside MUZE on this journey and can’t wait to see what’s next.
Here’s to more years of creativity, growth, and inspiring music together.
BBCC Leeds Trade Mission
Leeds, UK
Trade mission to Leeds with the British Bulgarian Chamber of Commerce (BBCC) female entrepreneurs.

Trade mission to Leeds with the British Bulgarian Chamber of Commerce (BBCC) female entrepreneurs, supported by the amazing Bob Spence (23-26 Sep). I am truly grateful to have been part of it as it was much more than a chance to share Flow Logic’s story of streamlining back-office workflows and driving AI adoption.
Few weeks are already behind and some reflections are standing to share:

Above all, it went far beyond a business trip. It became a platform for inspiration, learning, genuine connection, and new friendships. I've joined other trade missions before, but this one was first and really one of a kind!
With so much power, energy and engagement we've showcased the strength and vision of Bulgarian women entrepreneurs on an international stage.
Leeds proved to be far more than a destination – it offered a stage for ideas, growth, and cross-border collaboration, and we could witness a vibrant business community in action.

We came back home with big smiles and long lists to proceed with - from following up with prospects and potential partners to sending pictures and best wishes. And as it turned out we have built a momentum:
A few interested parties already came or plan to fly to Bulgaria soon to explore investment and trade opportunities.

Women leaders of the British Bulgarian Chamber of Commerce (BBCC) Board joined for a special roundtable-style lunch curious to hear our experiences and eager to commit to what's next. (more on that in another post ).
Cross-collaboration within our group is already moving forward, with several initiatives in motion.
The list with people to greet and thank is long - and I trust many of you will recognize yourselves. Looking forward to staying connected and seeing what the future unfolds.

Desislava Miteva, Maria Sivkova, Genoveva Christova, Kristiyana Gavrailova, Margarita Stoichkova, Izabel Stolarska, and remotely Elena Yordanova - it was privilege to share the BBCC female entrepreneurs trade mission with you .

P.S. And if you made it to the end, yes, the picture is from The Green Park London, no pic from the beautiful Leeds - we simply didn't have a spare minute there, so we took an hour before the airport on our way back
Leeds Digital Festival
Leeds, UK
Between 23–26 September, the BBCC Executive Director will lead a delegation of Bulgarian women entrepreneurs to the Leeds Digital Festival.
Between 23–26 September, the BBCC Executive Director will lead a delegation of Bulgarian women entrepreneurs to the Leeds Digital Festival.

The group represents some of the most dynamic and forward-thinking leaders in Bulgaria’s entrepreneurial ecosystem. Their visit is not only about exploring opportunities in the UK market, but also about sharing their own experiences, challenges, and ideas with peers from the British business community.
Each of the participants brings a unique perspective and innovative approach to business, and we are proud to support them in presenting their work on an international stage.
The Leeds Digital Festival provides an ideal platform for this exchange, bringing together businesses, investors, and innovators from across the digital and tech sectors.
If you would like to connect with the delegation and hear more about their projects, please reach out—we’ll be glad to introduce you.

YEPA EU-OECD Workshop
Brussels, Belgium
Last week, I had the opportunity to speak during the second OECD-EU Youth Entrepreneurship Policy Academy's workshop...

This program aims to connect policy makers, government figures, and young experts from UK, France, Belgium and Eastern Europe. We had the chance to participate in the process of developing innovative EU youth programs and to share our business plans.
Together with Areeba Rehman, Emilė Radytė and Yasemin Yusuf we shared our stories as well as the specific business challenges each of us is currently facing.
I talked about Conversion Century, our partnership with MUZE, and the process of internationally developing the first 360-degree marketing agency.
Special thanks to Младите Дами в Бизнеса / Young Ladies in Business who are official partners of YEPA for Bulgaria.
